text:
Chloe R.: Hey team — got an Azure Marketplace invoice that includes a line called 'Mediation fee (partner pass-through)'. We didn't expect a mediation charge for this reseller channel. Invoice ID INV-AGG-8345. Snippet below:
```
LineItem: Mediation fee - $3,412.00
Partner: Channel-Edge Resellers Ltd (partner id 4432)
Marketplace SKU: redwood-prod-oneday
```
Anyone seen this? Is this a passthrough or a double-bill?

Priya K.: Can you drop the subscription id? Also which settlement month? I'll pull the marketplace settlement CSV and check mapping.

Chloe R.: Sub: sub_987654321, settlement month: 2025-11 (invoice dated 2025-12-05).

AzureMarketplaceBot: Settlement file uploaded: s3://redwood-settlements/azure/2025-11/partner-4432.csv (checksum ok)

Carlos D.: Channel-Edge usually passes through mediation fees when the aggregator adds a platform/mediation charge. Did we change partner pricing or routing? @Maya FYI.

Maya F.: We ran a pricing experiment in Nov that bumped distributor margin by 0.5% for a subset of channel partners. We didn't expect mediation fee lines to show as separate invoice items on our customer invoices — pinging billing eng to confirm.

Liam S.: Priya — in your reconciliation do mediation fees map to marketplace_fee or partner_commission? If mapping changed in the ETL, that could cause the invoice render to duplicate.

Priya K.: Quick look: settlement CSV contains a 'mediation_fee' column. Our ETL currently maps it to 'partner_commission', but the invoice-flattening script (deployed in Nov) expects that value in 'marketplace_fee'. Looks like a field-mapping mismatch introduced with the Nov deploy.

Chloe R.: So customer-facing invoice shows it as marketplace fee AND our ledger may have recorded a partner pass-through = double-count? If so we need to issue credits.

Priya K.: If ledger has both settlement and pass-through postings, yes. I'll run a reconciliation for sub_987654321 and any siblings and flag duplicate postings.

James L.: If credits are required to channel partners or customers, legal needs to sign off on the communication template. If it's a platform bug, include remediation plan and proposed customer-facing message.

Maya F.: Priya, can you triage and post a short summary in #finance when you have a delta > $0? Also include full list of affected partners and estimated $ impact.

Priya K.: Will do. ETA EOD PST. Short-term mitigation: rollback ETL field mapping in staging and reprocess Nov settlements to measure delta.

Liam S.: I'll hold off payments to Channel-Edge for that payout batch until we confirm amounts. :eyes:

Chloe R.: Thanks all — attaching invoice PDF here: drive.redwood/INV-AGG-8345.pdf

Priya K.: Update: found 4 subscriptions impacted (including sub_987654321), total potential overcharge $4,125. Filing GL adjustment and payment hold.

Priya K.: Filed GL ticket FIN-GL-2025-089 and opened billing bug BIL-2025-412. Will post reconciliation CSV and breakdown in #finance thread when done. Closing thread when adjustments post.
